definitions.name: W2C.MEAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 0 [ ADD ] FOLD V LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector.

definitions.name: W2C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET 0 [ ADD ] FOLD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a numeric Vector: mean of the sorted elements at floor((n-1)/2) and floor(n/2).

definitions.name: W2C.VARIANCE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V W2C.MEAN 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D D MUL W2C.MEAN
definitions.note: Population variance: mean of squared deviations from the mean.

definitions.name: W2C.CAP
definitions.body: 'WD' BIND WD LOWER CHARS 'CH' BIND CH 0 GET UPPER CH 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Capitalize one word: first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

definitions.name: W2C.ISPRIME
definitions.body: 'K' BIND K 1 K RANGE G0A.MOD [ 0 EQ ] FILTER LENGTH 2 EQ
definitions.note: TRUE when a positive integer K has exactly two divisors in 1..K (K mod each d in 1..K, count zeros).

definitions.name: W2C.COLSTEP
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'X' BIND A 1 GET 'C' BIND X 2 DIV X 3 MUL 1 ADD X 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT 'NX' BIND X NX X 1 EQ SELECT 'FX' BIND C C 1 ADD X 1 EQ SELECT 'FC' BIND FX FC 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step for Collatz: state [x steps]; a step halves or triples-plus-one x unless x is already 1.

definitions.name: W2C.FIBSTEP
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 GET A 0 GET A 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: SCAN step for Fibonacci: state [a b] becomes [b a+b]; the lane's a is F(k).

definitions.name: W2C.LINE
definitions.body: 'O' BIND O 'price' GET 'P' BIND 0 O 'qty' GET P MUL P NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: Revenue of one order: qty times price, or 0 when the order has no price.
